lines.t: Oh I’ve seen it, yes I’ve seen it…
But not like this before…
I have watched the sun come risin’ on Israel’s high hills
Seen the moonlight lay so gently on Judah’s quiet fields
I have seen the heavens tremble, stars fall from the sky
But never such a wonder has ever met my eyes
There was a light before me, shining pure and true
A perfect holy image, deeper than I knew
I stepped into the fire, but it did not bring me pain
It filled my soul with wisdom, healed every hidden stain
Oh the flame, it did not harm me
It lifted me instead
What I thought would surely end me
Brought new life where I was dead
More, give me more
Of Your glory, Lord I’m reaching for
More, forevermore
Let Your presence pour and pour
I was lost but now I see
Your love is washing over me
More, my heart outpours
I don’t want less… I want more
Oh what a place of beauty, wrapped in holy light
Love so full and endless, burning warm and bright
It held me as I trembled, it raised me as I fell
Tears like rivers flowing, but I was held so well
I felt my life was leaving, yet I did not fade
Something deep within me was suddenly remade
The presence of the Mighty rose up in my soul
And where I once was broken, I was finally whole
Was I standing in the heavens?
Or somewhere yet untold?
Then I heard it in the silence—
“This is My Kingdom, behold”
More, give me more
Of Your glory, Lord I’m reaching for
More, forevermore
Let Your presence pour and pour
I was lost but now I see
Your love is washing over me
More, my heart outpours
I don’t want less… I want more
There before me stood a Man in light
Shining strong and burning bright
Hands and feet, the marks I see
Love poured out for souls like me
He called me close, I felt Him near
Every doubt just disappeared
Arms wide open, drawing me
Into His eternity
More, give me more
Of Your mercy I can’t ignore
More, forevermore
Every breath is Yours, oh Lord
I was dead, now I’m alive
Your life in me will never die
More, my spirit soars
I don’t want less… I want more
More… more…
Just a little more…
More… more…
Forever Yours…
